result.instructions: Pass native absolute paths and 1-based positions. Omit instanceId for automatic routing by uri; use list_instances only to inspect or disambiguate projects. When a symbol position is uncertain, locate it with document_symbols for a known file or workspace_symbols for a project query, then reuse the returned range start. For writes, always follow the preview-to-apply flow described by the lsp or workspace tool.

tools.name: editor
tools.description:
Read live editor state from one Neovim instance without modifying buffers or files.

OPERATIONS
- current_context: current buffer, cursor, mode, cwd, window, tab, filetype, modified state, and attached LSP clients. Pass instanceId.
- list_buffers: editable loaded file buffers with visibility, modified state, line count, filetype, and attached LSP clients. Pass instanceId; set includeSpecial=true to include plugin, terminal, help, and other special buffers.
- read_buffer: read live buffer text, including unsaved changes. If no matching live buffer exists, read the saved file from disk and return source=disk. Pass uri; startLine/endLine are optional 1-based inclusive bounds. maxLines defaults to 200.
- get_selection: current Visual, Visual Line, or Visual Block selection with 1-based range and selected text. Pass instanceId.

read_buffer can route automatically by uri; current-state operations require instanceId because they have no file path to disambiguate. list_instances is informational, not a prerequisite: read_buffer falls back to disk when no instance exists. This tool is read-only.

includeSpecial.description: Include plugin, terminal, help, and other special buffers in `list_buffers`; defaults to false

instanceId.description:
Instance ID from `list_instances`; required for current-state operations
On CLI, injected as a global option by `set_routing`

maxLines.description: Maximum lines returned for `read_buffer`, defaults to 200

timeoutMs.description:
Optional timeout in milliseconds on Neovim side
On CLI, injected as a global option by `set_routing`

uri.description: Native Unix or Windows absolute path for `read_buffer`

tools.name: health
tools.description: Report the vv-mcp server and registry status.

tools.name: list_instances
tools.description: Inspect currently registered Neovim instances. This is informational only: an empty result does not mean LSP is unavailable. Call lsp with uri to reuse a matching instance or automatically start a managed headless instance.

tools.name: lsp
tools.description:
Execute an LSP operation through the Neovim instance matching `uri`.

PATHS AND POSITIONS
- Pass a native absolute path. Unix: /home/user/file.ts. Windows: C:/work/file.ts.
- Plain paths are recommended; do not manually construct file:// URIs.
- Input and output positions are 1-based. Output range `45:17-45:32` can be reused as line=45, character=17.
- Do not guess symbol positions. For a known file, call document_symbols first. For a project search, call workspace_symbols with query.

CHOOSE BY INTENT
No position required:
- document_symbols: outline symbols in one file; optional query and symbolKinds filters.
- workspace_symbols: search project symbols; requires query.
- diagnostics: diagnostics for one file; optional severities, sources, and codes filters.
- workspace_diagnostics: diagnostics under a workspace path; optional severities, sources, and codes filters.
- document_links: navigable targets in one document.
- inlay_hints: inferred types and parameter-name hints; optionally accepts startLine and endLine.
- prepare_call_hierarchy: create call graph nodes at a symbol position and return callId values.
- incoming_calls, outgoing_calls: query one graph layer by callId; returned nodes include new callId values for further traversal; set includeExternal=false for workspace-only nodes.

Symbol position required:
- hover: signature and documentation.
- definition, declaration, type_definition, implementation: navigation locations.
- references: project references grouped by file; includeDeclaration defaults to true. Set includeExternal=false to keep workspace files, or pathPattern to match a normalized path substring.
- document_highlight: semantic occurrences in the current document.
- code_actions: fixes and refactors available at a position.

Call-site position required:
- signature_help: pass a position inside the intended call argument.

SAFE WRITE FLOWS
- Rename: prepare_rename -> rename_preview(newName) -> rename_apply(renameId).
- Specific fix: code_actions -> code_action_preview(actionId) -> code_action_apply(actionId).
- Fix a document: fix_document_preview -> code_action_apply(actionId). It prefers each LSP's source.fixAll and falls back to diagnostic quick fixes.

When no matching Neovim is running, the server starts one managed headless instance for the target project and reuses it until its idle timeout. Preview operations never modify files. Apply operations save to disk and reject stale, expired, reused, or overlapping edits. Command-only code actions are not executed. List results are compact and limited by max-results.

actionId.description: Code Action ID; candidate actions must be previewed first, full-document fix IDs skip preview

actionKind.description: Optional kind filter for `code_actions`, e.g. `quickfix` or `refactor.extract`

callId.description: Call hierarchy node ID; returned by prepare or previous level query

character.description: 1-based column number; `signature_help` must pass a position inside the target call argument

codes.description: Optional diagnostic code filter for `diagnostics` and `workspace_diagnostics`; numeric codes match as strings

endLine.description: Optional end line for `inlay_hints`, 1-based inclusive; omit to read entire file

includeDeclaration.description: Include symbol declarations in `references`; defaults to true

includeExternal.description: Include dependencies and external results in `references`, `incoming_calls`, and `outgoing_calls`; defaults to true

instanceId.description:
Instance ID from `list_instances`; usually omitted for automatic routing by uri, disambiguates overlapping instances
On CLI, injected as a global option by `set_routing`

line.description: 1-based line number; required for position operations, prefer reusing range start from symbol queries

newName.description: New symbol name; required only for `rename_preview`

operation.description: LSP operation to execute; some apply operations write to disk and must follow the safe write flow

pathPattern.description: Optional path substring filter for `references`; use plain Unix path fragments, not glob or regex

query.description: Symbol search query; required for `workspace_symbols`, optional for `document_symbols` (case-insensitive)

renameId.description: Transaction ID from `rename_preview`; required only for `rename_apply`

startLine.description: Optional start line for `inlay_hints`, 1-based; omit to start from file beginning

timeoutMs.description:
Optional timeout in milliseconds on Neovim side for slower language servers
On CLI, injected as a global option by `set_routing`

uri.description: Native Unix or Windows absolute path; plain paths recommended, also accepts file URIs

tools.name: resolve_instance
tools.description: Resolve one active Neovim instance by instanceId or absolute file path.

uri.description: 用于自动匹配工作区的 Unix 或 Windows 绝对路径

tools.name: workspace
tools.description:
Safely rename a file or directory inside one Neovim workspace.

OPERATIONS
- rename_resource_preview: requires oldUri and newUri. Collects workspace/willRenameFiles edits, validates paths and live buffers, and returns a single-use resourceRenameId without modifying files.
- rename_resource_apply: requires resourceRenameId and the same instanceId used for preview. Revalidates the transaction, applies import/reference edits, renames the resource on disk, synchronizes loaded buffers, saves edits, and sends workspace/didRenameFiles.

Both paths must be absolute and remain inside one workspace root. Modified buffers under the source path must be saved before preview. Apply rejects stale, expired, reused, conflicting, or unsupported resource edits.

instanceId.description: list_instances 返回的实例 ID；apply 阶段必须复用 preview 所在实例

newUri.description: 预览阶段的目标文件或目录绝对路径

oldUri.description: 预览阶段的源文件或目录绝对路径

operation.description: 要执行的工作区资源操作

resourceRenameId.description: rename_resource_preview 返回的单次事务 ID

timeoutMs.description: 等待 LSP willRenameFiles 响应的超时时间，默认 5000ms
